purpose: Targeted primary-source evidence for mature partial-gravity industry and early durable-infrastructure candidates
status: Physical screening and conditional economics; no commercially qualified lunar advantage established over both optimized Earth and orbital factories
reading_boundary: Individual records distinguish abstracts, indexed text, retrieved full text and selected figure inspection. Access failures remain recorded. This is not a full scholarly literature review. Temporary external PDFs and rendered pages are not redistributed.
